title: Top 3 Earners
description:
You are given an `employees` table. Return the **names** of the top 3
employees by salary, highest first. If fewer than 3 rows exist, return
all of them.

**Schema:**
```
employees(id INT, name TEXT, salary INT)
```

examples.explanation: Sorted by salary desc: B(300), D(250), C(200).

hints: Cap the row count with LIMIT 3.

sql_spec.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE employees (id INT, name TEXT, salary INT);
sql_spec.reference_query: SELECT name FROM employees ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 3;
sql_spec.starter:
-- Write your SQL query below
SELECT name FROM employees
